semantics.definition: A square base with rounded corners, four sockets underneath for the drone’s studs and small lights on its sides, a round plate, a short neck, and a wide head that looks to the front with two lenses side by side, each with a thin lime ring. Matte black, its glass glossy black. One can look through it.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one camera module every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: View the world from a drone; let one look through it.

state.resting: its head still, looking to the front
state.viewing: its head turning slowly from side to side, looking round
